record.body:
## Rationale

`composer:idea` uses the `current` lifecycle with a `status` enum of `open`, `promoted` and `dismissed`, changed by `supersede`. This matches `score:backlog-item`, so phase backlog-to-idea converts each record one-to-one. Triage can add enum values later as an additive minor bump.

## Counter-argument

The `question` lifecycle already has `deferred` and `closed` states and changes state with `update --transition`, which keeps one record id per idea. A parked idea is a natural `deferred` state.

payload.choice: composer:idea uses the current lifecycle with status open | promoted | dismissed
